scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 53 boards of 18 live Deity Online Small Continents runs of 2026-11-10 (Russia Religion and Sweden Culture seats) whose census shows a same-land rival capital seen by turn 90 within 24 tiles, each the run's events.jsonl cut before the second state frame of a turn from 2 turns after that capital was first seen (at least t38), then 12 and 24 turns later, before t104. Both arms run one frozen ci-profile civvis_orders (sha256 prefix a8722eb5a89f) built from origin/main 21d2ba563f with this branch at 61c19929fd (plus #5022 and a draft, both off in both arms), with the run's own requested genome (summary.json forced, each as --with), --victory domination and --resumed; the on arm adds --with domination-target-gets-its-breaker. Orders differ on 9/53 boards, each a pre-war breaker claim matched to the walls in an idle queue the off arm fills otherwise: a battering ram for walls 0-100 on 8 boards, a trebuchet for Chalco's 300 walls at t88.
